mapper.select: SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.BRANCH_ID, TS.MEMBER_ID, TS.GOVT_ID, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TN.CARID_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO as CAR_NO, TN.OWNER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, TN.REGIST_DATE FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID WHERE TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TS.PROC_ST = 'P_END'
SELECT MEMBER_NM AS SPECIALIST_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(MPHONE_NO) AS SPECIALIST_HP_NO FROM TM_MEMBER_DT WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{MEMBER_ID}

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.CAR_NO, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TS.COMPANY_ID, TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.MEMBER_ID, TCD.CUSTOMER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TCD.SERVICE_ID AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('P_REQ', 'PBEND') AND TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TS.WORK_CD = '010'
SELECT MEMBER_NM, COMPANY_ID, BRACNH_ID, MEMBER_GB, TEL_NO, MPHONE_NO FROM TM_MEMBER_DT WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{MEMBER_ID}
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_SERVICE SET PROC_ST = 'S_REQ', JUDGE_ST = 'S_REQ', UPD_DATE = SYSDATE, UPD_USER = 'SCHEDULAR' WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND PROC_ST = 'P_END'
